text.body:
[incipit frag. CUL Or. 131.1 fol. 2]-tā | te ca <sarve> (perhaps deleted) bhagavatā vyākṛtā |
evam eva mañjuśrīr bhikṣavo daśabhiḥ kalpair vimalaprabhāṣe kalpe duṣprasahasya tathāgatasya buddhakṣetre ekānu [+ + +] myaksambodhim abhisambotsyante |
praṇidhānālaṃkāravyūharājanāmānas tathāgatā ekanāmadheyā bhaviṣyanti |
evam ma [+ + +] ñjuśrīr bodhisattvānām asya dharmaparyāyasya śravaḥ | yaś ca mañjuśrīḥ kalpasahasraṃ ṣaṭsu pāramitāsu careta upāyakauśalavi [+ + +] ś cemaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ likhitvā'bhiśraddhadhāno 'rdhamāsasyātyayena ekām api vārāṃ vācayet | sa pūrvakapuṇyaskandho 'sya śatatamī [+ + +] nopaiti |
sahasratamīm api śatasahasratamīm api saṃkhyām api kalām api upamām api upaniśām api yāvad aupamyam api na kṣamaḥ [|]
tasmāt tarhi mañjuśrīḥ parindāmite imaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ | imāni caivaṃrūpāṇi mama bodhisattvā dhārayantu paścātkāle cāyaṃ dharmaparyāyo dhā [+ +] tavyo deśayitavyaḥ |
tadyathāpi nāma mañjuśrī rājā cakravartī yāvat tiṣṭhati | tāvat saptaratnāni nānatardhīyante | kālagataś ca rājā cakravartī bhavati | antardhīyante [+ + +] pta ratnāni |
evam eva mañjuśrī yāvad idam evaṃrūpāḥ sūtrāntā loke pracariṣyanti tāvat tathāgatasya saptatriṃśadbodhipakṣā dharmā nāntardhās[+ + +] antarhiteṣu caivaṃvidheṣu sūtrānteṣu buddhadharmasyāntardhānaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tasmāt tarhi mañjuśrī imāny evaṃrūpāṇi sūtrāntaratnāni | u+i + kha dhāraya vācaya deśaya | nāsucārabdha(?) vīryair bhavitavyaṃ bodhisattvair mahāsattvai iyam asmākam anuśāsanām | mā paścād vipratisāri [+ + +] ṣyatheti ||
idam avocad bhagavān āttamanā sumatir bodhisattvo mañjuśrīś ca kumārabhūtas te ca bodhisattvās te ca bhikṣavaḥ sā ca sarv[+ + +] sadevamānuṣyāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti ||
sumati{r}dārikānāmamahāyānasūtraṃ samāptam || o || śubham astu [+ + +]
